articles.title: US Air Force adopts new Force Design focusing on sensors and autonomy
articles.summary: The Air Force's new Force Design 2026 outlines a shift toward artificial intelligence, autonomy and integrated sensors to counter emerging threats.

articles.title: New Hampshire National Guard breaks ground on new Plymouth Readiness Center
articles.summary: The New Hampshire Army National Guard broke ground Nov. 12 on the Plymouth Readiness Center, beginning a $31 million project to replace the community’s 1957 armory with a modern, secure facility built for current and future missions.

articles.title: Air Force Band ensembles honor veterans across the nation
articles.summary: The U.S. Air Force Band's Ceremonial Brass performed live at NBC's TODAY Show plaza, Nov. 11, 2026, anchoring a series of nationwide performances honoring America’s veterans through music.

articles.title: Judges close part of ICC Afghanistan investigations that could look at US troops
articles.summary: The International Criminal Court will close investigations into Afghanistan that previously looked at alleged crimes by U.S. troops and focus only on actions of the Taliban.

articles.title: WHY I Serve: Soldier’s Determination Leads Her to Army Service at 41
articles.summary: At 41, many people have settled into established careers and routines. Pfc. Olivia Kabre, a nutrition care specialist at Landstuhl Regional Medical Center, chose a different path: She enlisted in the U.S. Army and completed basic combat training, pursuing a goal she had held for years.

articles.title: Oregon Guard Soldiers bring Army fitness, Veterans Day lesson to Salem middle school
articles.summary: Three Oregon Army National Guard Soldiers spent the day before Veterans Day at Crossler Middle School, leading students through Army-style physical training and talking with them about the veterans in their own families.

articles.summary: The redesignation follows President Donald Trump’s push to replace references to artificial intelligence with “super intelligence” across the federal government.

articles.title: T-19A Kestrel makes debut flyover at U.S. Air Force Academy
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force Academy cadets were treated to a historic aerial display today as the Air Force’s newest aircraft, the T-19A Kestrel, made its official public debut during a flyover of the Cadet Wing’s noon meal formation.

articles.title: ACC-RSA celebrates Leadership Development and Readiness Program Graduates
articles.summary: U.S. Army Contracting Command-Redstone Arsenal recognized 21 employees who completed the Leadership Development and Readiness Program's Level II Practitioner Course during a Nov. 4, 2026 ceremony at Toftoy Hall on Redstone Arsenal, Alabama.

articles.summary: Thirty-three contracting fellows graduated from U.S. Army Contracting Command-Redstone Arsenal’s Green Platoon program during a ceremony on Oct. 5 at Heiser Hall on Redstone Arsenal, Ala.

articles.title: SSN(X) Attack Boat Will be a Swift, Lethal Mothership for Undersea Drones, Navy Says
articles.summary: ARLINGTON, Va. — The next American nuclear attack submarine design will be faster, take less time to repair and serve as a mothership for a constellation of undersea drones, the Navy’s head of requirements for submarines said on Thursday.

articles.summary: The measures call for enhanced cooperation between the U.S. and Israel on weapons technology development.

articles.title: Washington Artillery marks 188 years at annual Pass in Review
articles.summary: NEW ORLEANS – The Louisiana National Guard’s 1st Battalion, 141st Field Artillery Regiment, Washington Artillery, commemorated 188 years of service during its annual Pass in Review ceremony in New Orleans, Nov. 8.

articles.title: U.S. Transfers Unmanned Surface Vessels to Philippine Marine Corps
articles.summary: The Philippine Marine Corps received two American-made unmanned surface vessels last week at Subic Bay as part of Washington’s efforts to bolster Manila’s asymmetric capabilities in the South China Sea and Luzon Strait. On Nov. 4, two Maritime Tactical Systems T38 Devil Ray USVs were transferred to the Philippine Marine Corps at Subic Bay.

articles.title: Pentagon ‘greenlit’ permanent presence of US troops in Poland, official says
articles.summary: The Pentagon “greenlit” the permanent presence of U.S. troops in Poland, with the final decision to be made by the White House in early December, Poland's defense minister said.

articles.summary: For more than 10 years, the FTI-MED program provided technical expertise in the design, development, procurement, integration, installation, and project management oversight for the implementation of Facility Communications Distribution Systems (FCDS) for the Department of Defense medical community.

articles.title: Giant salvinia discovered on Millwood Lake
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers is alerting Millwood Lake visitors that giant salvinia, an invasive aquatic plant, was discovered in the lake in late October 2026.

articles.summary: U.S. Navy Cmdr. J. Anderson Ayala took command of the “Bloodhounds” of Air Test and Evaluation Squadron (VX) 30 from Capt. Barry Carmody during a Nov. 10 ceremony at Point Mugu.

articles.title: Cleveland Harbor Fall Dredging Completed in Just Over Two Weeks; Completes $11.7M Annual Operation
articles.summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Buffalo District, completed fall dredging of Cleveland Harbor in just over two weeks, ensuring safe and navigable waterways for Great Lakes commercial vessels, recreational boaters and other harbor users on Lake Erie.

articles.title: 103-year-old D-Day vet receives French Legion of Honor Medal
articles.summary: The French government bestowed its highest medals for honor to a 103-year-old World War II veteran during a ceremony held at the U.S. Army Institute for Religious Leadership, Nov. 10.
